recognize_zh: 整片紅血球中有大量「牛眼狀」標靶細胞（target cells）：外圈血紅素、中間淡染環，正中央又有一團血紅素；同時紅血球偏小、淡染且大小形狀不一，在 β 型重度地中海貧血孩童的血片中是典型表現。
features: Numerous target cells (codocytes) with a central dot of hemoglobin surrounded by a pale ring and a peripheral hemoglobinized rim
Red cells predominantly small and hypochromic
Anisopoikilocytosis with oval, teardrop-like and irregular forms
Target cells evenly distributed across the field, favoring a true finding over drying artifact
Part of a granulocyte at the lower edge; image is out of focus, limiting assessment of inclusions such as basophilic stippling
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells distributed evenly across the field, together with microcytic, hypochromic red cells and moderate anisopoikilocytosis including oval and teardrop-like forms. The image is somewhat out of focus, so basophilic stippling, nucleated red cells and other inclusions cannot be reliably assessed. A portion of a granulocyte is seen at the lower margin. Findings are consistent with a thalassemic red cell disorder such as beta-thalassemia major, as reported, and hemoglobin fractionation is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbC disease shows target cells with spherocytes and HbC crystals and HbE shows milder microcytosis, both identified by an abnormal variant on HPLC or electrophoresis rather than the high HbF of beta-thalassemia major.
Liver disease produces normocytic or macrocytic target cells from membrane lipid gain, without microcytosis, hypochromia or marked poikilocytosis.
Asplenia shows target cells with Howell-Jolly bodies, acanthocytes and Pappenheimer bodies in a normocytic background.
Artifactual targets from slow drying or humidity are unevenly clustered in thick areas of the smear, whereas the targets here are uniformly distributed with accompanying microcytosis.
